# NovaPanel v1.6.141

- Fixed dashboard system metadata placeholders, firewall labels, and running/stopped status text across all supported locales.
- Made logger reconfiguration safe alongside concurrent log writes, and aligned Sing-Box tests with Go 1.27 linkname requirements.
- Parallelized release builds with acceptance checks while keeping every required check as a release-publication gate.
- Added the Sing-Box 1.16 compatibility and staged-upgrade checklist.
